description: Dependency updates (D1 §6.3, D3 §6.3, D10 §6.10). Conventional Commit messages size the next release for release-please and buildlogic.git-version: fix(deps) → patch release; ci(deps) for CI-only updates releases nothing.

packageRules.description: Spring Boot plugin and BOM move together (DL-23: 4.x minors tracked, majors by decision).
The Deephaven server image pinned for the ITs and the Deephaven Java client stay on one version (test-infra/compose/versions.env, gradle/libs.versions.toml).
Company base images are tagged <yyyymmdd>-<n> by base-image.yml (D3 §6.1).
Workflow actions (majors pinned) are CI-only changes.

customManagers.description: Test-infra images pinned as <image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest> in test-infra/compose/versions.env (D10 §6.10).
